passive.name: Bravado
passive.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

primaryAbilities.name: Starlight's Touch
primaryAbilities.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Gain a stack (max {{ maxcharges }}) every {{ stackcooldown }} seconds and when hitting a Bravado Attack.

Active: Consume all stacks to restore {{ healingperstack }} Health per stack to nearby ally champions ({{ maxstackhealing }} at {{ maxcharges }} stacks).{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Bastion
primaryAbilities.description:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Taric gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and forms a tether between him and the ally bound by this Ability. As long as they are near each other, the ally gains {{ bonusarmor }} Armor and Taric casts all his Abilities from both himself and his linked ally.

Active: Taric binds to an ally champion, granting a {{ shieldhpratio }}% max Health Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Dazzle
primaryAbilities.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Taric projects a beam of starlight, bursting after {{ chargeduration }} second to deal <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stun</status> enemies for {{ stunduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Cosmic Radiance
primaryAbilities.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Taric calls down protection from the heavens. After {{ initialdelay }} seconds, nearby ally champions become invulnerable for {{ invulnduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
